$comment: User-facing facts that are not views: the panel, the right-click commands and the settings. The view list comes from src/modules/insights/views/catalog.json. `npm run docs` writes the generated parts of README.md and builds the GitHub Pages site from both files; `npm run docs:check` fails when they disagree with the code (see scripts/docs.mjs).
tagline: See your Zotero library as networks and charts.
intro: Zotero Bibliometero adds an Insights panel to Zotero. Click the chart button in the tab bar and a panel opens under your item list with interactive views of your library: who writes with whom, which journals you read, how your collection grows year by year. Everything runs inside Zotero, with no account and no data leaving your computer.

panel.title: Opens under your item list
panel.text: The chart button in the tab bar opens Insights as a dock below the item list, so your library stays in view. Drag the divider to resize it; Zotero remembers the height.

panel.title: Maximize to a full tab
panel.text: Maximize moves Insights into its own Zotero tab for a bigger canvas. Restore puts it back in the dock, on the same view.

panel.title: Whole library or a curated set
panel.text: The switch in the header picks what the views show: your whole library, or a curated set of papers you choose. The set is kept per library and does not touch your tags or collections.

panel.title: Click through to your items
panel.text: Charts link back to the library. Click a year, a source, an author or a slice to find those items; click a paper in the author/paper network to open it.

panel.title: Export any view
panel.text: Export PNG and Export SVG save the current view as an image, ready for slides or a paper.

panel.title: Stays up to date
panel.text: Add, edit or delete items and the open view refreshes on its own. Light and dark themes follow Zotero unless you pick one in Settings.

commands.label: Add to Insights
commands.text: Adds the selected items to the curated set. When all of them are already in the set, the command reads Remove from Insights instead.

commands.label: Remove from Insights
commands.text: Removes the selected items from the curated set.

commands.label: Add collection to Insights
commands.text: Adds the items in the collection to the curated set. Items that are only in its subcollections are not added.

items.label: Default view
items.text: The view Insights shows when there is no last-used view to return to.

items.label: Theme
items.text: auto follows Zotero; light and dark force one look.

items.label: Source
items.text: Whole library or Curated set. Same as the switch in the panel header.

items.label: Top-N (ranked charts)
items.text: How many bars Top sources and Top authors show. The Top-N box in each chart's header overrides it for that chart.

install: Download zotero-bibliometero.xpi from the latest release.
Click the gear icon, choose Install Plugin From File, and pick the downloaded file.
installNote: Installed copies update themselves when a new version is released.
